_doc: Mitigoke manual plan. JSON has no comments: every field is described in the project's local_mit_plan/CONTEXT.md. Times are SECONDS SINCE PULL. Delete the _doc keys before use, or leave them, they are ignored.
title: My plan

fight.name: My Fight (Savage)
fight._doc_phases: Optional. Shown as a tag next to the clock.
fight._doc_mechanics: Optional. Named time windows. A mechanic groups the casts that fall inside it, and groups the cues in the queue.
fight._doc_bossActions: What you are mitigating. type is "tb" (tankbuster) or "raid".

_doc_players: One entry per slot. job may be a real job (PLD, WHM…) or a role (TANK, HEALER, MELEE, RANGED, CASTER).
_doc_assignments: startTime is when the ability must be PRESSED, in seconds since pull. abilityId should come from mapping.json; anything else needs an entry in "abilities" below.
_doc_abilities: Optional. Only needed for abilities missing from mapping.json, or to override a name or icon. Keys are the abilityId used above.
